item.artDescription: An engraving on this furniture depicts a thousand eggplants. The scene takes place on the outskirts of a town.

This furniture is engraved with an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> holding hands with <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye God</color> during a marriage ceremony while others look on solemnly. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> is blowing air at <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye</color>. The work is infused with the idea of illness and is done in a heartfelt style. This artwork relates to the marriage of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye</color> on 13th of Jugust, 5501.

This furniture bears a portrayal of a group of raiders covered in gore. Seven comedians flee the area. If you squint your eyes, the static composition of the image reveals the outline of six anteaters. The work is infused with the idea of harmony and is done in a surrealistic style. This representation refers to an assault on <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s campsite on 13th of Jugust, 5501.

An engraving on this furniture portrays <color=#D09B61FF>Susumu 'Dweeb' Russell</color> winning at a horseshoes pin, planning his next action. <color=#D09B61FF>Dweeb</color> towers above the scene. The impressionistic style of the central scene clashes with the surrealistic depiction of the background. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Dweeb</color> playing games at a horseshoes pin on 4th of Jugust, 5502.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of a hill.

This furniture bears a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Skylar 'Sky' Baker</color> poised over the chess table, tense with energy. In the distance, a pit is visible. The work is infused with the idea of sympathy and is done in a detail-oriented style. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> enjoying herself at a chess table on 8th of Decembary, 5501.
This furniture bears an illustration of a prime abstract shape. Almost every shape in the image seems to be square.
This furniture bears an illustration of a dancer playing dice with hundreds of spiders. At the edge of the image are a group of yams. The image contrasts loneliness with seclusion.

This furniture is engraved with an artwork of an overwhelming force roaring in victory. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> organizes a resistance while flexing his muscles. A hyena poses to the left of the main scene. The work has an unoriginal feeling and a square structure. This portrayal relates to an raid on <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s city on 1st of Aprimay, 5501.
This furniture is engraved with a representation of a gauntlet.
This furniture bears an artwork of a solitary fortune teller rendered in silhouette near a pit. The work seems to symbolize solitude. Thousands of hummingbirds appear in the lower part of the image.

This furniture is engraved with an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye God</color> brutally incapacitating <color=#D09B61FF>Dozith Thaov</color> with a human out of bleak necessity. <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color>'s eyes are closed. The lower part of the image is dominated by three squares. The work is infused with the idea of decency and is done in an unoriginal style. This portrayal refers to the harming of <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> by <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye</color> on 12th of Aprimay, 5504.
This furniture bears an illustration of an abstracted rendering of solidarity. An armadillo is shown beneath the main subject.

An engraving on this furniture depicts <color=#D09B61FF>Susumu 'Dweeb' Russell</color> losing at a chess table, wearing a scarce look. Nine maids are slumped in defeat. The work is executed in a surrealistic style. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Dweeb</color> relaxing at a chess table on 14th of Septober, 5501.
This furniture bears an illustration of a district. The horizontal structure of the image almost conflicts with its expressionistic style. The subjects are in front of four lentils.

This furniture bears an illustration of a fabulous pattern of green rays floating over a township. Eight yaks wander peacefully. A mountain far from the main subject represents the artist's agony. This artwork refers to the time an aurora appeared over <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s township on 1st of Aprimay, 5501.

This furniture bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> putting together a small altar with a gleam in his eye. The small altar appears to tower above <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>. There is a settlement in the distance. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on a small altar on 4th of Aprimay, 5501.

An engraving on this furniture portrays <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> packing supplies for a journey and equipped for exploration. A thicket is visible in the distance. A drunkard waits in the background. This depiction refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> departing for adventure on 12th of Decembary, 5503.
This furniture is engraved with a representation of an empty duster. The subjects are in front of thousands of beets.

This furniture bears an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> welcoming <color=#D09B61FF>Skylar 'Sky' Baker</color> as she becomes a colonist with obvious goodwill. <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> looks hopeful. At the edge of the image are six maids. Almost every shape in the image seems to be square. This artwork refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> being recruited by <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> on 1st of Decembary, 5501.

This furniture bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Susumu 'Dweeb' Russell</color> threatening <color=#D09B61FF>Katia Maddox</color> while <color=#D09B61FF>Katia</color> punches him. <color=#D09B61FF>Katia</color> is visibly wounded. The image contrasts emptiness with camraderie. A politician to the right of the main scene represents the artist's poverty. This portrayal refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Dweeb</color> assaulting <color=#D09B61FF>Katia</color> on 6th of Septober, 5501.
This furniture is engraved with an image of a pine tree. A monster behind the focal point makes the viewer think of oppression.

An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> packing supplies for a journey and equipped for exploration. A bramble is visible in the distance. There is a campsite in the background. The style is symbolic with erotic elements. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> forming a caravan on 14th of Septober, 5503.
An engraving on this furniture resembles a tail.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of a blacksmith surrounded by devils. The work represents the artist's loss. Provocatively, at the edge of the image are seven gunsmiths.
This furniture bears an illustration of a witch doctor riding on a pig wearing a duster playing poker with nine bears. The overall composition is rectangular.
This furniture bears a portrayal of a smuggler looking nutty eating an artichoke. Dozens of pirates appear near the main subject.

This furniture is engraved with a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Popogg 'Snout' Pwosquoer</color> being slain by <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> seemingly without remorse. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> seems satisfied. The work is infused with the idea of death and is done in a complex and realistic style. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of a thousand ants. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> mutilating <color=#D09B61FF>Snout</color> in melee with a breach axe on 2nd of Aprimay, 5504.

On this sculpture is an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> building a geothermal generator while smiling proudly. The geothermal generator glows a soft green. The image contrasts silence with fun. The lower part of the image is dominated by an aspen tree. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on a geothermal generator on 8th of Jugust, 5501.
An engraving on this furniture portrays a large group of yams. The minimalistic style of the central scene clashes with the cubist depiction of the background.
This furniture bears an artwork of an ellipse. The work represents torture.

An engraving on this furniture is shaped like <color=#D09B61FF>Skylar 'Sky' Baker</color> studying the secrets of pulse-charged munitions alone at her bench. <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> is staring at her discovery with a sense of wonder. This depiction refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> finishing research on pulse-charged munitions on 2nd of Decembary, 5503.

An engraving on this furniture illustrates <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> polishing the surface of a wastepack atomizer while wiping the sweat from his forehead. Four acrobats gaze in awe. The subjects are in front of five triangles. Almost every shape in the image seems to be horizontal. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on a wastepack atomizer on 11th of Septober, 5503.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of an abstracted rendering of camraderie. Seven jaguars appear near the edge of the image. The work makes the viewer think of brotherhood.

This furniture bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Bluejay Mibanbrei</color> being disabled by <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> in a cowardly, halfhearted way. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> looks pleased with the situation. The work seems to symbolize agony. This representation relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> harming <color=#D09B61FF>Mibanbrei</color> with a club on 5th of Decembary, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture depicts <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> buying goods from <color=#D09B61FF>Gregorio Suero</color> with greedy intent. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> pays for the item. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of a group of squares. This portrayal refers to a trade between <color=#D09B61FF>Gregorio Suero</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> on 12th of Decembary, 5500.

This furniture is engraved with an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye God</color> sitting next to the billiards table, wearing a destroyed look. In the distance, a settlement is visible. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye</color> playing games at a billiards table on 10th of Decembary, 5503.
This furniture is engraved with an artwork of a gauntlet.
This furniture bears a portrayal of a javelin. A cook off to one side suggests the concept of plenty.
This furniture is engraved with an image of a circle. Ten bears appear in the upper part of the image. The work seems to express safety.

This furniture bears an illustration of a brightly-glowing spot falling to the ground in a cloud of ash. Nine hyenas mill around uncertainly. This representation relates to a meteorite impacting near <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s encampment on 12th of Aprimay, 5501.

This furniture is engraved with an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Dozith Thaov</color> crouching next to a fire while covered in frost. The scene takes place inside a snow-covered aspen forest. This image tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> getting hypothermia on 10th of Aprimay, 5504.

An engraving on this furniture represents <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye God</color> punching <color=#D09B61FF>Dozith Thaov</color> while <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> kicks her. <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> is consumed with passionate rage. The work has a figurative feeling and a rectangular structure. The subjects are in front of dozens of centipedes. This image relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye</color> fighting <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> on 12th of Aprimay, 5504.

An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> huddled in the shade of a cliff while vomiting. Five unmoving koalas surround the scene. This representation tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> getting heatstroke on 12th of Decembary, 5503.

This furniture bears a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> buying goods from <color=#D09B61FF>Michael 'Binsy' Binns</color> with greedy intent. <color=#D09B61FF>Binsy</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> agree on a price. This image relates to a trade between <color=#D09B61FF>Michael 'Binsy' Binns</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> on 1st of Aprimay, 5504.
This furniture bears an image of the minor celebrity Mayumi rendered in silhouette. The work is infused with the idea of confinement and is done in a rococo style.

An engraving on this furniture portrays <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> polishing the surface of an uranium slug turret with a satisfied expression on his face. The uranium slug turret is intricately detailed. The work reminds the viewer of loss. Besides that, there is a forest beneath the main subject. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on an uranium slug turret on 4th of Septober, 5503.

An engraving on this furniture is shaped like <color=#D09B61FF>Katia Maddox</color> poised over the poker table, wearing an isolated look. In the distance, a brook is visible. This portrayal relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Katia</color> enjoying herself at a poker table on 1st of Aprimay, 5504.

An engraving on this furniture resembles <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> inscribing his name on an armchair with a satisfied expression on his face. The armchair appears to tower above <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>. Eight beasts appear in the background. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on an armchair on 1st of Jugust, 5502.
This furniture bears a depiction of an automaton surrounded by beavers.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of a gardener seen through a looking glass playing poker with hundreds of barbarians. A machine persona avatar sits beneath the main subject. The work is executed in a classical style.

An engraving on this furniture portrays <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> slicing into <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye God</color> during surgery as she trembles with fear. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> has blood smeared on his face. This image tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Jaye</color>'s medical operation on 7th of Aprimay, 5504.

An engraving on this furniture represents <color=#D09B61FF>Dozith Thaov</color> practicing cooking skills while covered in sweat. Her skill is visible in the work. At the edge of the image are a group of vampires. This portrayal refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> becoming a master at cooking tasks on 7th of Aprimay, 5504.

This furniture bears an illustration of an enormous demon attacking five boxers. Ten beggars flee the area. The scene takes place in the middle of a district. The image contrasts despair with silence. This illustration tells the story of an assault on <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s township on 2nd of Aprimay, 5504.

This furniture bears a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Skylar 'Sky' Baker</color> winning at a billiards table, her body loose and relaxed. Ten brewers are playing as well. At the edge of the image are seven artichokes. This image relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> relaxing at a billiards table on 2nd of Decembary, 5501.

This furniture bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Dozith Thaov</color> getting a drink from <color=#D09B61FF>Susumu 'Dweeb' Russell</color> while laughing uproariously. Dozens of tarsiers play nearby. This image relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Thaov</color> attending <color=#D09B61FF>Dweeb</color>'s party on 3rd of Decembary, 5503.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of the minor celebrity Carlos sitting on a table.

This furniture bears a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> trying to light a fire while exhaling clouds of fog. A cold blue moon looms in the background. The scene takes place on the outskirts of a district. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> getting hypothermia on 2nd of Jugust, 5501.
This furniture bears an illustration of a cook moving to the left holding a pistol. The style is post-impressionistic with hyper-realistic elements.

An engraving on this furniture depicts <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> inscribing his name on a small altar while smiling proudly. Several hypnotists marvel at the small altar. The style is expressionistic with pop art elements. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on a small altar on 7th of Decembary, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture represents <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu God</color> building a geothermal generator while covered in grime. Dozens of tailors marvel at the geothermal generator. The work is shaded in hues of gray and purple. A pirate near the main subject seems to express hunger. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> finishing construction on a geothermal generator on 9th of Jugust, 5501.
This furniture bears an artwork of a settlement. Several rhinos appear off to one side.

An engraving on this furniture depicts eight deers milling around uncertainly in darkness, twilight blanketing a nearby canyon. A settlement of spectators watches the sky peacefully. The work is infused with the idea of safety and is done in a sensual style. This image relates to an eclipse over <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s village on 9th of Decembary, 5500.
This furniture is engraved with an illustration of a cliff.

An engraving on this furniture illustrates <color=#D09B61FF>Purple Manatee</color> being crippled with passionate rage. A boxer watches silently behind the focal point. The work is executed in a minimalistic style. At the edge of the image are four hearts. This portrayal relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> disabling <color=#D09B61FF>Purple</color> on 2nd of Decembary, 5504.
This furniture is engraved with a depiction of a hill. The heartfelt style of the central scene clashes with the impressionistic depiction of the background.

An engraving on this furniture represents <color=#D09B61FF>Katia Maddox</color> striking compacted steel with a satisfied expression. <color=#D09B61FF>Katia</color> is wiping her brow. The overall composition is triangular. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Katia</color> striking compacted steel on 12th of Decembary, 5504.

This furniture bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Sezdovvin Dovox</color> crouching next to a fire while exhaling clouds of fog. A group of dying rams lay on the ground. If you squint your eyes, the vertical composition of the image reveals the outline of a dancer. The work is infused with the idea of hardship and is done in a heartfelt style. This depiction refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Sezdovvin</color> getting hypothermia on 4th of Jugust, 5504.

This furniture bears an artwork of stylized purple banners covered in guts. <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color> wields a scimitar defensively while glowing black. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of ten lines. The overall composition is well-balanced. This portrayal relates to an assault on <color=#D09B61FF>Surematu</color>'s village on 2nd of Decembary, 5504.

This furniture is engraved with a representation of a huge rock trailing green flames blazing across the sky. <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color> looks on with excitement. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of six carrots. This illustration refers to a meteorite falling near <color=#D09B61FF>Sky</color>'s village on 9th of Septober, 5504.

An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>Susumu 'Dweeb' Russell</color> searching for water with cracked dry lips. A group of dying hornets lay on the ground. Hundreds of farmers appear beneath the main subject. This portrayal refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Dweeb</color> overheating on 1st of Decembary, 5504.
An engraving on this furniture portrays an abstracted rendering of triumph. The static structure of the image almost conflicts with its dadaist style.
This furniture bears a representation of a city. The work conveys the emotions of revenge. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of hundreds of engineers.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of four rapiers. Almost every shape in the image seems to be static. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of nine cowboys.

li.combatLogText: The uranium slug turret's uranium slug crushed <color=#D09B61FF>the guinea pig</color>'s body to pieces.
